# LETTER 1 OF 2

Daet, Camarines Norte 
October ___, 2026

**THE REGISTER OF DEEDS**

Registry of Deeds for the Province of Camarines Norte

Daet, Camarines Norte

| **Re:** | **Request for certified true copies of registered instruments and Primary Entry Book entries relating to Transfer Certificate of Title No. T-52540 (Heirs of Mary Worrick Keesey), Entry Nos. 2021003235 and 2021003236, both of November 23, 2021** |
|---|---|

Sir/Madam:

I write for and on behalf of my mother, **PATRICIA KEESEY ZSCHOCHE**, one of the registered owners named in Transfer Certificate of Title No. T-52540 and in Transfer Certificate of Title No. 079-2021002127, under the apostilled Special Power of Attorney attached as Annex "A", which authorizes me to request records of the estate's properties from this Registry. A copy of my identification is attached as Annex "B".

Under Section 56 of Presidential Decree No. 1529, all records and papers relative to registered land in this office are open to the public in the same manner as court records, and certified copies of all instruments filed and registered may be obtained upon payment of the prescribed fees. I respectfully request certified true copies of the following, and I undertake to pay the fees assessed:

1. **The Partition-Subdivision Agreement** dated March 15, 2017, Doc. No. 402, Page No. 81, Book No. CXXII, Series of 2017, of Notary Public Donald E. Asis of Daet, registered on TCT No. T-52540 under **Entry No. 2021003236** on November 23, 2021, **in full, with every page, signature page, acknowledgment, annex and attachment** filed with it.

2. **The complete registration file of Entry No. 2021003236**: every instrument, plan, technical description, tax clearance, certification, letter, authorization and other paper presented in support of that entry. I note that the certified copy issued to me under Ref. No. 2025001096 (OR dated February 25, 2025) contained only the subdivision plan (LRA) PSD-E2020005406 and the technical descriptions, and not the Partition-Subdivision Agreement itself.

3. **Certified copies of the Primary Entry Book pages** (Section 56, first paragraph, PD 1529) for Entry Nos. 2021003235 and 2021003236, showing the date, hour and minute of reception, the instruments received, the fees paid, and **the name of the person who presented them**, together with any receipt, authorization or identification taken from the presenter.

4. **The record of the surrender of the owner's duplicate** of TCT No. T-52540 (the duplicate issued under Entry No. 2017000693 of March 16, 2017) upon the registration of November 23, 2021: by whom it was surrendered, and any receipt or notation made.

5. If any item above, in particular the Partition-Subdivision Agreement in item 1, **is not on file** in this Registry, a **certification to that effect**, stating what documents are on file for Entry No. 2021003236.

This is a follow-up to my earlier requests of September 30, 2020 and February 25, 2025 for the complete records of the transactions on TCT No. T-52540. In response to the 2025 request this Registry issued the complete file of Entry No. 2021003235 (Ref. No. 2025001098, 25 pages), which I hold and do not ask for again, and the file of Entry No. 2021003236 (Ref. No. 2025001096, 8 pages), which contained the plan and technical descriptions only; the Partition-Subdivision Agreement was never furnished. The registered owners need these records for Civil Case No. 26-360 pending before the Municipal Trial Court of Mercedes, Camarines Norte, in which the Registry's entries of November 23, 2021 are in issue.

Kindly assess the fees and I will pay them upon notice. I may be reached at the address below and at jonzschoche@gmail.com. Thank you.

Respectfully,

 
 
______________________________

**JONATHAN PAUL ZSCHOCHE**

Attorney-in-fact of Patricia Keesey Zschoche

Sir/Madam:

I write for and on behalf of my mother, **PATRICIA KEESEY ZSCHOCHE**, a registered co-owner of the land covered by Transfer Certificate of Title No. T-52540 of the Registry of Deeds for Camarines Norte, under the apostilled Special Power of Attorney attached as Annex "A". A copy of my identification is attached as Annex "B".

Under Rule VI of the 2004 Rules on Notarial Practice (A.M. No. 02-8-13-SC), every notary public keeps a notarial register recording, for each act, the parties, the instrument, the date, the fees, and the competent evidence of identity, with the signature of the person who appeared; and under Section 2(h) of the same Rule the notary forwards to this Office, within the first ten days of the following month, a certified copy of each month's entries together with a duplicate original of every instrument acknowledged. I respectfully request certified copies of the following records on file with this Office, and I undertake to pay the fees assessed:

**I. Notarial register of Atty. Donald E. Asis, Notary Public for Daet, Camarines Norte**

1. The register entry and the duplicate original on file for **Doc. No. 402, Page No. 81, Book No. CXXII, Series of 2017**: a Partition-Subdivision Agreement dated March 15, 2017, concerning TCT No. T-52540 (Geraldine K. Hoppe, Patricia K. Zschoche and Marcia Ellen Keesey) and Gloria H. Balane.

2. The register entry and the duplicate original on file for **Doc. No. 115, Page No. 23, Book No. CXXII, Series of 2017**: a Deed of Confirmation dated March 28, 2017, executed by Cesar M. de la Fuente.

3. The register entry and the duplicate original on file for **Doc. No. 304, Page No. 61, Book No. CXVI, Series of 2016**: a Deed of Absolute Sale dated September 29, 2016, executed by Cesar M. de la Fuente in favor of Gloria H. Balane.

4. The certified monthly entries of **Book No. CXXII for March 2017** in full, so that the sequence of Doc. Nos. 115 and 402 within the month can be seen, and the **monthly report for September 2016** covering Doc. No. 304.

**II. Notarial register of Atty. Elaine Gay R. Belen, Notary Public for Daet, Camarines Norte**

1. The register entry and the duplicate original on file for **Doc. No. 560, Page No. 112, Book No. XI, Series of 2016**: an Affidavit of Loss dated September 27, 2016, executed by Cesar M. de la Fuente.

2. The register entry and the duplicate original on file for **Doc. No. 55, Page No. 17, Book No. IX, Series of 2012**: a Special Power of Attorney dated February 29, 2012, executed by Cesar M. de la Fuente in favor of Salvador O. dela Fuente.

3. Any register entry for **Doc. No. 019, Page No. 04, Book No. XIV, Series of 2021** (a Special Power of Attorney of Gloria H. Balane in favor of Karen Gay A. Elevado, acknowledged in Daet on September 15, 2021). The notary's name on the copy available to me is not legible; if this entry is not in Atty. Belen's register, I request a certification identifying the notary public of Daet whose 2021 register carries that document, page and book number, and the entry itself.

If any instrument above was not reported to this Office, or no duplicate original is on file, I request a **certification to that effect** for each such item.

The registered owners need these records for Civil Case No. 26-360 pending before the Municipal Trial Court of Mercedes, Camarines Norte, in which the instruments listed above are in issue, and in particular to establish who appeared before the notary for the Partition-Subdivision Agreement in item I-1, which none of the registered owners signed.
